text: Program Description Note: If you apply for this course, you will study with international students in North campus 4 years. If you want first 2 years study with international students and last 2 years study with Chinese students in South campus, you can apply International Econimics and Trade >>. 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: This program pays much attention to the education of international business theory. ​ This program is aimed at helping students to have a good knowledge of the basic theories, fundamentals and skills of the English Language and international business management theory. This program cultivates students with a primary capability for conducting academic research. This program can provide students for a high-quality and multi-functional career in both international business management and cross-cultural communication. 2. Courses Information Editor Notes: Main courses have listed for students to reference to. Core courses: Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, Management Principles, International Marketing, Accounting Principles, International Business Law, Financial Management, Human Resource Management, International Finance, Organization Behavior Science,etc. 3. Students' Employment Editor Notes: The annual employment rate of graduates is over 99.6%. The graduates, with a polished competitive edge, are very popular with employers, enjoying a high rate of quality employment. They are mainly employed by the "Fortune 500 Enterprises", the four largest international accounting firms, businesses dealing in foreign trade, and foreign-related enterprises. 4. Institute for International Education (IIE) Introduction Editor Notes: IIE has enrolled 2154 students from 111 countries and regions. IIE has become one of the global HSK test centers and one of the New HSK online test centers, the first one in South China. The School is in the list of the first group of receiving institutes for Confucius Institute Scholarship. The School will take part in national projects and event, facilitate faculty and management training. 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: GDUFS has become a key university in Guangdong Province with international reputation in foreign languages and business education. Guangdong University of Foreign Studies (GDUFS) is located in Guangzhou, the capital city of Guangdong Province and the largest business center in China. Guangzhou is the largest city in this region and the 3rd largest metropolis in China, following only Beijing and Shanghai. Guangzhou has long enjoyed fame as the renowned historic and cultural centre, the exciting economic hub of the country and is often referred to as "the Southern Gate of China" , Learn More>> 6.
